angle_3points — 3D geometry op

• Data kinds: points → measurement

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.angle_3points(a, b, c) (to call the implementation directly, import match3d; match3d.angle_3points(a, b, c); from the registry, ops3d.get("angle_3points"))

Usage

The angle at three points (vertex b, in degrees). ∠ABC.

Returns arccos(û·v̂) (u = a − b, v = c − b) in degrees (float). The value is in [0, 180] and has no sign (even in 2-D the direction of rotation is not distinguished). The arguments are numeric 2- or 3-vectors; mixed dimensions raise ValueError. If a == b or c == b, the dot product with the zero vector is 0 and 90 is returned (no exception). The dot product is clipped to [−1,1], so numerical error does not produce NaN.

Uses: measuring bend angles and joint angles, the angle around the intersection of 2 lines obtained by fit_line_3d.
